name: SAGE
summary: SAGE measured solar electron neutrinos with a metallic-gallium radiochemical target deep below the Caucasus. Its low capture threshold includes pp neutrinos, complementing chlorine and real-time water detectors.
detection_principle: Gallium-71 captures an electron neutrino and becomes germanium-71. Chemical extraction isolates the germanium atoms, and low-background proportional counters measure their decays. Strong artificial-source calibrations also informed the gallium anomaly.
